# Content-addressed cache makes recompiles free and stable

A content-addressed cache is used so identical inputs produce 100% cache hits and avoid repeated LLM calls. The cache is deliberately repo-agnostic, and unique model_id values are used in tests to avoid cross-test cache contamination.
